exercises.title: Health & Advice — Reading
exercises.passage: Leo has a sore throat and feels tired. His mother tells him to rest and drink water. He should not go to football practice today. If he still feels unwell tomorrow, he will make an appointment with a doctor.

questions.question: Why should Leo rest?
questions.answer: He has a sore throat and feels tired

questions.question: What will he do if he is still unwell?

exercises.title: Health & Advice — Listening
exercises.script: Patient: I have a headache. Doctor: You should rest and drink water. Patient: Can I go running tonight? Doctor: Not today. You should stay at home.
